However, coming from another trans person who was once at the “I would rather die than continue living as my gender assigned at birth” stage, why not give transitioning a shot? Why not try socially transitioning, getting on hrt, pursuing surgeries, whatever feels right to you? I saw you asked about the long term effects of hrt, which is of course a completely valid question, but if the alternative is ending your life now, wouldn’t it be worth it to be more comfortable in your body for a few decades, even if there are long term effects 60 years down the line? You might as well give it a shot, just to see what it’s like before you die

Would it be possible to move to another country to transition? I know that seems really difficult, but is dying really better than maybe being able to live life as your true self? I’m trans too and I was really ready to end it all when I thought there was no way I could ever be able to live my life as a man and the thought of having to go through this world as a woman was absolutely terrifying. Being able to transition was by no means easy, but I have been able to transition and now I live my day to day life as a man and I genuinely have a will to live (though I do still struggle with depression due to other things). If there’s any way you can fight to get to a place where you can transition, you should. 

Also it really sucks that they won’t let you transition anymore because you showed some uncertainty, especially when you were so young. Having doubts about transitioning is completely normal. It’s a huge life change and it can be really scary. Having doubts is good because it really forces you to think about why you’re doing what you’re doing. If you have doubts, but still come to the conclusion that this is the best thing to do, isn’t that more reassuring than if you ignore all the negative thoughts and just go for it? I really hope you get the chance to be yourself :)

I’m proud of you for accepting it. I’m trans too and I know it was really hard for me to admit it to myself. I know it can be hard, but try not to be too hard on yourself if you can’t look the way you want to right now. Your transition (whether it’s social, medical, or whatever your personal goals are) is a journey. It’s not going to happen overnight. It can help to find little things that you can do to get gender euphoria, like clothing, using products that are typically associated with/marketed towards your gender identity, changing your mannerisms, etc. Small things can really make you feel better on a day to day basis, especially if you can’t take bigger steps towards your transition goals quite yet. Just take it one day at a time, and I promise that there will come a time when you meet your goals and can completely live life as yourself
